facts.fact: 第四大道上被称为「书街」的一段，是 Caroline 全城最偏爱的地方，Gertrude 的 Blackbird Book Shop 就在其中。
facts.anchor: Fourth Avenue, specifically the stretch known as Book Row

facts.fact: Caroline 羡慕 Gertrude：整天被书包围，还独自住在书店楼上的一间小公寓。
facts.anchor: she also lived in a tiny apartment above the shop alone

facts.fact: Orson 的佣人以为 Caroline 要去费城照料生病的表亲，为期两周。
facts.anchor: Orson’s staff believed I was tending to a sick cousin in Philadelphia for the next two weeks

facts.fact: 为了维持这个骗局，Patricia 留在布鲁克林陪着母亲，等该回城的时候再回去。
facts.anchor: Patricia was staying in Brooklyn with her mother until it was time to return uptown

facts.fact: Caroline 承认 Zane 完全出乎她的意料——她不再把外貌的冲击当成判断他的依据。
facts.anchor: He wasn’t at all what I’d assumed.

facts.fact: 午餐时 Caroline 认定 Zane 既有智慧又有机智，两人的交谈轻松愉快，甚至像在互相打趣。
facts.anchor: it was clear he possessed intelligence and wit

facts.fact: 在 Gertrude 与 Bess 面前，Caroline 把婚后 Orson 的转变比作 Jekyll 与 Hyde 换了一个人。
facts.anchor: It’s like they are two different people—the man before the wedding and the one after.

facts.fact: Caroline 想到把卖书的钱交给以股票发家的 Zane 代为投资，作为自己计划的第一步。
facts.anchor: Everyone knew Zane built his fortune on stocks. Would he be willing to take the book money from me and invest it?

facts.fact: Zane 让厨子为 Caroline 准备了一枚草莓马卡龙，放在白瓷盘上等她发现。
Caroline 只咬了一小口马卡龙就停下，Zane 一度怀疑巴伐利亚厨子没按正宗配方做。
facts.anchor: She took a tiny nibble of the macaron, then placed it back on the plate and sat down.

facts.fact: Zane 认定 Caroline 并不想让他在身边——但她很快就主动上门找他说话了。
facts.anchor: And it isn’t as if she wants me around.

facts.fact: Caroline 指出：有钱的是丈夫与父亲，而作为妻子的自己一无所有——这是她要一笔钱的原因。
facts.anchor: My husband is rich. My father is rich. But me, a wife? I have nothing.

facts.fact: Zane 听说 Caroline 要卖掉自己的藏书，立刻抢着要买下那批书。
facts.anchor: “I will buy them from you,” I blurted.
